POSSIBLE OWNER FINANCING WITH LARGE DOWNPAYMENT

Escape to the outdoors with this well-maintained Breckenridge park model, offering the perfect seasonal retreat or weekend getaway. This 2-bedroom, 2-bath home comfortably sleeps up to six and features full-size appliances, forced-air furnace heat with supplemental electric heat, and two window air conditioning units to keep you comfortable year-round.

Set near approximately 4,000 acres of state land, outdoor enthusiasts will appreciate the nearby snowmobile trails and endless opportunities for hiking, hunting, and recreation. A detached garage provides excellent storage for vehicles, ATVs, snowmobiles, or outdoor gear.

Major updates include a 50-year shingle roof on the park model (2015), a new metal roof on the garage (approximately 2010), and a new well pump installed just two years ago. The home is equipped with a 1999 forced-air furnace and has been thoughtfully maintained over the years.

Whether you're looking for a hunting camp, snowmobile basecamp, or a peaceful place to unwind in nature, this property is ready for its next owner to enjoy.
